aboutPage.title: Bridging Ethiopian Origins With Global Roasters
aboutPage.subtitle: Born in Addis Ababa, trusted across 40+ countries.
aboutPage.storyP1: BCS Coffee Market Consulting was founded in 2009 by a team of Ethiopian coffee professionals who saw a gap between the country's extraordinary coffee heritage and the international buyers seeking it. We've spent fifteen years closing that gap visit by visit, container by container.
aboutPage.storyP2: Today our consultancy operates as the trusted intermediary between verified Ethiopian exporters and roasters in Europe, Asia, North America, and the Middle East facilitating over $50M in trade and shipping more than 5,000 tons.
aboutPage.heritageP1: Ethiopia is coffee's birthplace. Our work honors that lineage by ensuring fair, transparent trade where producers, exporters, and buyers all win.

origins.homeSubtitle: Ethiopia is the birthplace of coffee — each region produces a distinct cup profile shaped by altitude, soil, and tradition.
origins.pageTitle: The Seven Regions of Ethiopian Coffee
origins.pageSubtitle: From the misty highlands of Yirgacheffe to the sun-baked plateaus of Harrar.

regionNotes.harrar: Blueberry, wine, mocha. Iconic dry-processed eastern coffee with a wild, fruited cup.
regionNotes.yirgacheffe: Floral, citrus, tea-like body. The most celebrated Ethiopian origin — bright, jasmine-laced, refined.
regionNotes.sidama: Berry, wine, sweet citrus. Diverse micro-climates produce remarkable lot-to-lot variation.
regionNotes.guji: Berry, chocolate, jasmine. A rising star with intense fruit-forward profiles.
regionNotes.limu: Balanced, spicy, winey. A reliable workhorse for blends and single-origin alike.
regionNotes.jimma: Earthy, mild, full body. Ethiopia's largest producing region by volume.
regionNotes.nekemte: Fruity, mocha, bold. Western-Ethiopian character — heavy body and chocolate.
